author: Riskayyy
body:
Hi all,
Just a quick update that is worth making public... Tanpiku has decided to step down from Official to Referee. His reasons will stay confidential unless he decides to announce it himself. In his replacement, we have decided to give Mango_ the role! 

Congratulations young Mango!

If you have any issues with a tournament map, direct them to Mango_

Thanks,
Officials.
